pages.text: $(thing)Wheat Stem Rust$() ($(o)Puccinia graminis f. sp. tritici$()), fungus.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() common wheat, durum wheat, barley, rye.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() airborne spores.
$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 15-35 °C (best 25 °C), humidity above 85%, 6 h of wet leaves.

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 0.5 years (alternate host).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 70% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Resistant cultivars (Sr genes); Eradicate barberry, the alternate host; Early sowing; Fungicide at flag leaf.
The Ug99 lineage, found in Uganda in 1999, defeated the widely used Sr31 resistance gene.
